csv_scope_of_work: To Provide Construction Management at Risk for project will consist of the new construction of a one-story Public Library. It is anticipated that the building will be approximately 21,275 square feet in size. The building will be constructed on 6.50 acres of land leased by LCG near the corner of Louisiana Ave and Carmel Drive. The 21,275 SF Branch Library is expected to include a large multipurpose room, classroom, library collection stacks, quiet reading room, study rooms, designated children's and teen areas, along with staff work areas and offices. The site will include parking, vehicular drop off, drainage, and outdoor program space yhe building will be constructed on land leased by LCG near the corner of Louisiana Ave and Carmel Drive

title: CMAR for Northeast Regional Library
short_description: Construction management at risk for a new 21,275-square-foot public library in Lafayette.
project_location: Lafayette, Louisiana, USA; near the corner of Louisiana Avenue and Carmel Drive
project_scope: New construction of a one-story public library of approximately 21,275 square feet on a 6.50-acre site. The program includes a large multipurpose room, classroom, library collection stacks, quiet reading room, study rooms, children's and teen areas, staff work areas and offices. Site works include parking, vehicular drop-off, drainage, and outdoor program space.
services: Construction Management at Risk (CMAR) for the project; requested disciplines include Design Build/Developer and Construction/Project Management.
relevance_explanation:
- Building project with moderate size but no notable long-span, lightweight, bridge, roof, or special structural features stated.
- Procurement is for CMAR/construction management at risk rather than structural design or engineering services.
- Public library building may involve coordination opportunities, but the notice does not indicate a planning or structural design component relevant to sbp.
- Construction cost is moderate, yet the project appears to be a conventional one-story building.
fee_explanation: No explicit engineering or structural design fee is stated. The tender is for CMAR services, not a separate structural engineering commission.
